title: Collecting litter
subtitle: Go2 + D1 × GPT-6-Astra · medium · Real world

clock.method: Constant offset from motion onset vs. logged command time at six anchors (walk 90.25/115.96 s, crouch 140.90/186.76/522.36/1420.32 s after 20:14:53); onsets lead commands by 2.12–2.26 s with no drift. Camera clock = session UTC − 20:14:55.2. SDK latency is unknown, so this is a bound to ~0.2 s.

device_map.description: Go2 + D1 silhouette from the supplied go2_d1.py URDF/profile dimensions; fixed illustrative pose, not live kinematics.

elapsed_time.clock: Original recording, retained through second deposit verification

disturbances.description: A person sweeps the brown paper away with a red broom, from in front of the gripper to beside the robot body. Found by tracking the paper and red pixels in the footage; not in the session log. The wrist frame read at source ~305.8 s shows the earlier position, and the next grasp (source ~367 s) closes on empty floor.

source_review.endpoint: Second paper visibly released; final wrist-camera result confirms deposit. Ends before retraction/searching. Two pieces collected, not all trash cleared.
source_review.framing: Entire original 16:9 recording letterboxed without crop or zoom.
source_review.motion_method: Every successful servo/device-write interval protected, including omitted calls; asynchronous writes extended by commanded duration plus 0.8s. Reviewed source motion and human disturbance.
